body: Land Use Committee - City Council Committee
name: Land Use Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  LAND USE COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, October 7, 2026 – 3:30 p.m.
  .
  .

To provide Public Comments, you may attend in-person at City Hall or submit your written
comments via email to the City Clerk's Office (cityclerk@wlv.org) no later than 11:00 a.m. on the
meeting date. Written comments will be provided to Land Use Committee Members prior to the
meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-Supplemental-Packets

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less
 than 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal
 business hours and are posted on the City’s Website -https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
 Committee-Supplemental-Packets

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your
 notifications.  Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or
 https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER  3:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Pro Tem Halpern and Councilmember Pearl

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Land Use Committee on items not on the printed agenda and within
the Council’s/Committee’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.

BUSINESS:

1.  Conditional Use Permit No. 26-004
  Applicant: Ronald Barron, on behalf of Universal Pro
  Project Address: 31360 Via Colinas, Suite 101
  Project Description: Request for a conditional use permit authorizing a new private
  instructional baseball facility.

2.  Conditional Use Permit No. 11-006, Modification No. 2
  Applicant: Anthony Parisi, on behalf of Fitness Factory LLC DBA FitBody
  Bootcamp
  Project Address: 31166 Via Colinas, Suite 1
  Project Description: Request for a time extension of a previously approved
  conditional use permit authorizing the continued operation of a fitness and
  personal training facility.

3.  Planned Development Permit No. 26-001
  Applicant: Emiliano Lopes, Jo & Bri Construction, Inc., on behalf of Pierce Brothers
  Valley Oaks Memorial Park
  Project Address: 5600 Lindero Canyon Road
  Project Description: Request to add an approximately 1,800 square-foot carport
  structure and 7,800 square-foot concrete pad at the maintenance facility serving
  Pierce Brothers Memorial Park. The expanded area would improve operational
  circulation and provide covered and open storage for excavation equipment, outer
  burial containers, monuments, and markers.

4.  Sign Modification Permit No. 96-008, Modification No. 1
  Applicant: Kaity Maines, on behalf of Costco Wholesale Corporation
  Project Address: 5700 Lindero Canyon Road
  Project Description: Request to modify an existing sign modification permit to
  remove the existing primary wall sign and replace it with a new 124-square-foot
  blue and red “Costco Wholesale” wall sign.

5.  Planning Department Update

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, October 2, 2026, at 11:00 a.m.. on the City’s website
and in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  October 2, 2026
